name: SALUTE
recent: SALUTE 近期有多项企业动作：子公司获 RM2.85mil 装修合约，同时涉及与 Apple 的专利诉讼上诉。此外，大股东 Lim 家族悉数退股，Chuah Chong Ewe 成为最大股东。
notable: 全资子公司 SLTC Venture 获得 Puncak Ecocity (Klang) 颁发的 RM2.85mil 装修与维修工程合约。
预计筹集最多 RM16.18mil，并计划多元化业务至房地产与建筑领域。
Chuah Chong Ewe 成为公司最大股东，持股 31.13%；Lim 家族成员及关联方悉数出售持股并退场。
risks: 可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
公司与 Apple 的专利诉讼仍在进行，上诉聆讯已结束，案件管理定于 2026 年 11 月 20 日。
公司处于亏损状态，且近期有多名大股东及董事退股或减持。

news.title: Salutica-Apple Patent Appeal Hearing Concludes, Case Management Set for 20 Nov 2026
Salutica unit secures RM2.85mil renovation contract in Klang
Salutica eyes RM16.2m placement to fund property expansion
Salutica proposes private placement to raise RM16.18mil, diversify into property and construction
LFE Corp chairman Chuah emerges as Salutica’s largest shareholder at 31.13%
Bursa Opens Mixed After BNM Keeps OPR Unchanged
Loss-making Salutica jumps nearly 48pct after Lim family exit
Salutica chairman and sons exit after selling all their shares

recent_en: SALUTE has seen several corporate developments recently: its subsidiary secured a RM2.85mil renovation contract, it proposed a private placement of up to RM16.18mil to diversify into property and construction, and it is involved in a patent appeal with Apple. Meanwhile, the Lim family exited as shareholders and Chuah Chong Ewe emerged as the largest shareholder.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary SLTC Venture secured a RM2.85mil renovation and repair contract from Puncak Ecocity (Klang).
The company proposed a private placement to raise up to RM16.18mil and plans to diversify into property and construction.
Chuah Chong Ewe emerged as the largest shareholder with a 31.13% stake; the Lim family and related parties sold all their shares and exited.
risks_en: The proposed private placement may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
Patent litigation with Apple is ongoing; the appeal hearing has concluded and case management is set for 20 Nov 2026.
The company is loss-making, and several major shareholders and directors have recently exited or reduced their stakes.
